svg.title: Full extent, continuous native inspection and local refinement
svg.desc: A self-authored generic atlas illustrates a source-coordinate inventory, adjacent native-coordinate inspection tiles and local residual checks connected back to the complete editable output. No real source image or aircraft coordinates are used.
